message.text:
Identifying which background runners the server starts and what triggers their scheduling.

`s3presign.Runner` starts in `server/server.go` and runs once immediately on startup, then repeats every 12 hours via a ticker.

Four webhook async workers launch in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` during package initialization. They process events from an async channel queue triggered by `PostAsync`, making them event-driven rather than scheduled.

`memopayload.Runner` is not started as a background worker. Its rebuild logic runs inline from request handlers instead.

The internal scheduler package exists but is not used by the server or command.

`recordPATUsage` runs as a fire-and-forget goroutine on authentication requests. It is not a scheduled runner.

The SSE heartbeat uses a per-connection ticker inside `sse_handler` when a client connects. It is not a global server runner.

The four webhook async workers launch via package initialization before the server starts. Whether they count as server-started runners is still being considered.

Only `s3presign.Runner` is explicitly started by the server. The four webhook workers launch via package initialization, not by the server itself.

`memopayload.NewRunner` is never invoked. `RebuildMemoPayload` is called directly from `memo_service.go`.

`s3presign.Runner` is explicitly started in `startBackgroundRunners` inside `server.go`. Webhook workers are launched at process startup through the `webhook` package `init()` because `main` imports it. These are the only background runners the server itself starts.

`s3presign.Runner` triggers every 12 hours, plus a one-time run at server startup. Webhook workers are four async goroutines fed by a buffered channel queue in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`. The `internal/scheduler` cron scheduler is unused by the server; it only appears in its own tests.

The HTTP server goroutine in `Start()` and ephemeral per-request `recordPATUsage` goroutines are not considered background runners.

q28.

s3presign.Runner — `time.Ticker` every 12 hours plus one immediate `RunOnce` at startup (`server/server.go` → `server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`)  
webhook async workers (4 goroutines) — buffered channel queue (`asyncPostQueue`) fed by `PostAsync`; started in package `init()` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go`), loaded because `cmd/memos/main.go` imports `internal/webhook`

**Unused scheduling infrastructure:** `internal/scheduler` (cron-based job scheduler in `internal/scheduler/`) is not imported or started by the server or `cmd/memos`; it is only referenced in its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go`, `internal/scheduler/integration_test.go`).

**Not started as background runners:**

- **`memopayload.Runner`** (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) — exists with `RunOnce`, but the server never starts it; only the synchronous helper `RebuildMemoPayload` is called from handlers (e.g. `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go`).
- **`s3presign.Runner`** is the only runner wired in `Server.startBackgroundRunners` (`server/server.go`, lines 153–173).
